insights: Local solvability = distribution solution exists for every smooth RHS
Condition (Ψ): Im(p_m) does not change sign from - to + along bicharacteristics of Re(p_m)
Nirenberg-Treves conjecture (1963, proved Dencker 2006): (Ψ) iff locally solvable for principal type
Elliptic operators satisfy (Ψ) vacuously - principal symbol never vanishes
Operators with real principal symbol satisfy (Ψ) trivially - Im = 0
Full proof requires microlocal analysis not in Mathlib
monomial_real proof: cast product of complex powers to ofReal product via norm_cast, then ofReal_im gives im=0. The original rw approach was structurally broken.

Bridge axiom imSymbolAlongCurve_spec (∃ x ξ, imSymbolAlongCurve γ t = (principalSymbol P x ξ).im) directly connects the bicharacteristic parameterization to the concrete principal symbol — this is the one missing axiom that unlocks both corollaries
real_symbol_solvable proof: from hreal (all Im=0) + bridge axiom, any hneg : imSymbolAlongCurve γ t₁ < 0 gives x,ξ with (principalSymbol P x ξ).im < 0, contradicting hreal via linarith

self_adjoint_solvable proof: formalAdjoint P = P implies principalSymbol P x ξ = starRingEnd ℂ (principalSymbol P x ξ) via principalSymbol_adjoint + rw[hsa]; then Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp gives Im=0; apply real_symbol_solvable
